measurement.linkage: static C API and runtime; single-threaded C++ operator new replacement
measurement.timing: steady clock around successful load or generate only; free, hashing and compilation excluded
measurement.allocations: C++ allocation calls and sum of requested bytes during each call; includes aligned new
not_measured: malloc/realloc in dependencies such as zlib
measurement.conditions: Local machine without CPU isolation, frequency pinning or exclusive host access; timings are observations

measurement.order: before/after on even rounds, after/before on odd rounds
measurement.conditions: Shared local host; no CPU isolation or frequency pinning
